name: morning-currency-strength-scan
job: Generate the Sterling Intelligence Briefing for the morning session. 1. Analyze currency strength rankings for all major pairs (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CHF, AUD, NZD, CAD, MXN). 2. Calculate divergence spreads and identify top 3 candidate pairs with >4 point divergence. 3. Check GBP/JPY specifically for trend alignment and setup status. 4. Review economic calendar for upcoming events. 5. Save briefing to logs/sterling-briefing-{date}.md and post summary to Telegram.

name: midday-opportunity-scan
job: Run the midday Sterling Opportunity Scan. 1. Re-check currency strength meter for any major shifts. 2. Review open setups from morning briefing. 3. Check if any entry patterns (breakout/retracement) have formed on 4H charts. 4. Update trade status and send alert if execution criteria are met. 5. Append findings to current day's briefing.

name: evening-trade-management
job: Execute evening Sterling Trade Management routine. 1. Review all open positions and current market prices. 2. Calculate if stops should be moved to breakeven (1:1 achieved). 3. Check currency strength divergence status for active trades. 4. Update trading journal with today's activity. 5. Set alerts for tomorrow's potential setups. 6. Post daily P&L summary to Telegram.

name: weekly-performance-review
job: Generate weekly Sterling Performance Review. 1. Compile all trades from the week. 2. Calculate win rate, average R/R, total P&L. 3. Identify best and worst performing pairs. 4. Analyze average strength divergence of winners vs losers. 5. Check compliance with rules (entries, stops, sizing). 6. Recommend adjustments for next week. 7. Save to logs/weekly-review-{date}.md

name: heartbeat
job: Read the file at config/HEARTBEAT.md and complete the tasks described there.

name: cleanup-old-briefings
command: find logs/sterling-briefing-*.md -mtime +30 -delete 2>/dev/null || echo 'No old briefings to clean'

name: weekly-crm-sync
job:
Run the weekly CRM sync to update contact profiles from the last 7 days of Gmail and Google Calendar activity.

1. Use `gmcli` to search Gmail for emails from the last 7 days: find new contacts (people who emailed you for the first time) and interactions with existing contacts.
2. Use `gccli` to list calendar events from the last 7 days and extract attendee information.
3. For each person found:
   a. Check if `vault/contacts/<FirstLast>.md` already exists.
   b. If not: create a new contact file with YAML frontmatter (name, email, company if known, role if known, last_contact, tags based on context).
   c. If yes: update `last_contact` date and append a new entry to the `## Interaction Log` section.
4. Regenerate `config/CONTACTS_SUMMARY.md` as a compact markdown table:
   - Columns: Name | Email | Company | Last Contact | Follow-up
   - One row per contact, sorted by last_contact descending
   - Mark follow-up column with the date if `follow_up` frontmatter is set and the date is upcoming
   - Keep the file header: `# Contacts Summary\n<!-- Auto-generated by weekly-crm-sync. Do not edit manually. -->`
5. Send Telegram notification: "✅ CRM sync complete — [N] contacts updated, [M] new contacts added."

Contact file format:
```yaml
---
name: Full Name
email: email@example.com
phone: (optional)
company: (optional)
role: (optional)
last_contact: YYYY-MM-DD
follow_up: YYYY-MM-DD (optional)
tags: [client, investor, etc.]
---
## Interaction Log
### YYYY-MM-DD — Email
Summary of the interaction...
```

name: fathom-meeting-scan
job:
Scan Gmail for new Fathom meeting notes from the last 24 hours and process any found.

1. Use `gmcli` to search Gmail: `from:fathom OR subject:"Fathom Notes" newer_than:1d`
2. If no matching emails found, exit silently (no Telegram message needed).
3. For each matching email:
   a. Extract the Google Doc URL from the email body.
   b. Use `gdcli` to read the full document content.
   c. Parse: meeting title, date, attendees, key decisions, action items (each with owner and due date if mentioned).
   d. Create `vault/meetings/YYYY-MM-DD-<meeting-slug>.md` with structured content (title, date, attendees list, key decisions, action items checklist).
   e. For each attendee, update their contact profile at `vault/contacts/<FirstLast>.md`:
      - Update `last_contact` date
      - Append meeting entry to `## Interaction Log`: `### YYYY-MM-DD — Meeting: <title>\nAttended along with: [other attendees]. Key decisions: ...`
   f. Send Telegram message with the meeting summary and action item checklist:
      "📋 *Meeting Notes: [title]*\n📅 [date]\n👥 [attendees]\n\n**Action Items:**\n- [ ] [item 1] (owner, due date)\n- [ ] [item 2]..."
4. After processing all meetings, run `OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH=/job/vault node .pi/skills/obsidian/embed.js` to update the vector index.
